date.as_written: samvat 834 mārgaśiravadi 4 budhavāra puṣyanakṣatra aidra yoga

notes: The era is not named ('samvat 834'), but the Newari script and the Newari phrase 'yāṅā dina' make it Nepāla Saṃvat. NS 834 begins in autumn 1713, so Mārgaśira kṛṣṇa 4 of NS 834 falls in Nov/Dec 1713 CE. NS+880 would give 1714, which is too late for this month. The closing phrase 'sā+rapāṭhapratiṣṭhā yāṅā dina' means 'the day on which the pratiṣṭhā of sā+rapāṭha (sārapāṭha?) was performed'. It marks the date as the day of a ritual, not the purpose of the copy. The word is damaged ('+'), so the reading is uncertain. No person is named in the colophon. The catalogue's king, Jaya-Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur (r. c. 1696–1722), fits the date, but he is not named in the quoted text, so he is not added.
